subnetName.description: Subnet name. Must be unique within the VPC.

cidr.description:
Subnet CIDR in IPv4 notation.

Constraints:
- Must be a valid CIDR (e.g. 172.16.0.0/24)
- Must not overlap with other subnets in this VPC
- Must not overlap with reserved ranges

Recommended: subsets of 172.16.0.0/12
